title: SDLC Task-Owned Identifier v1
description: A repository-unique identifier for an entity declared by one task. The task UID is followed by an underscore and the entity's historical type-prefixed local identifier.
$comment: TaskOwnedIdentifier has the form {TaskUid}_{TYPE-###}, for example WI-0003-05000000_OBJ-001 or WI-0003-05000000_CHANGE-001. The task UID makes the entity unique without relying on an implicit current-task context.
